cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Lose Something for Me
cards.instruction: Create a loyalty test by asking them to accept a real disadvantage on your behalf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come to my opening night instead of the prize ceremony. I'll keep the front-row seat for you once you've chosen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm receiving the prize. I'd miss hearing my own name.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know. That's why your being here would count. You can send congratulations any night; tonight I'd like you in the seat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's an unfair test. I could come to tomorrow's performance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tomorrow would be welcome. It won't answer tonight's question. I'll hold the seat until you tell me whether missing your moment for mine is something you're willing to do.

reason: Use B next-day compromise as the concrete alternative A judges insufficient for this costly loyalty test; preserve genuine warmth toward later attendance while reserving authority over what counts tonight.
